title: Fluxion — Sankey Flow Editor
description: Write flows as plain text, get a publication-grade Sankey diagram you can drag, restyle and export as SVG, PNG or JSON.
concept: Fluxion turns a three-word-per-line syntax — Source [value] Target — into a live Sankey diagram. A from-scratch layout engine assigns columns by longest path, scales every ribbon to one vertical unit, and relaxes node positions across iterative passes; back edges that would close a loop are reported instead of smeared across the canvas. You can drag any node vertically to pin it, hover to trace a flow's share of its source, retune width, gap, curvature, relax passes, alignment, palette and ribbon colouring, then export the result as vector SVG, a 2x PNG, or portable JSON. Everything autosaves locally and the whole diagram packs into the share link.
features: Flow DSL with live parsing, per-line error reporting and node colour pinning
From-scratch Sankey engine: longest-path columns, value scaling, iterative relaxation, collision resolve
Cycle detection — a back edge is skipped and explained instead of breaking the layout
Drag any node vertically to pin it; double-click to release; pins persist
Hover tracing with tooltips showing each flow's share of its source
Ten style controls: node width, gap, curvature, relax passes, alignment, 6 palettes, 4 ribbon colour modes, opacity, label size, unit suffix
Four worked presets: global energy, startup burn, signup funnel, plastic flow
Export vector SVG, 2x PNG and JSON; copy a share link that carries the whole diagram
localStorage autosave, auto-widening scroll canvas and a tabbed layout on phones

interaction.mouse: Hover a ribbon or node to trace it and read its share; drag a node up or down to pin its position
interaction.click: Switch presets, flip alignment and ribbon colour modes, append flows, export SVG/PNG/JSON or copy a share link
interaction.touch: Tabbed Diagram / Data / Style panels, drag-to-pin nodes, and a horizontally scrollable canvas that widens so labels stay legible
interaction.keyboard: Type flows directly in the editor; Enter in the quick-add row appends a flow and chains the next one
